node.title: Re: Global in RE not working as expected?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
When the regex engine replaces the first ",," with ",NULL,", it does not continue matching inside of the replacement string, so the only thing left for it to match and replace is the last two ",,". One solution is zero-width [doc://perlre#Lookaround-Assertions]:

my $sql = ",,,,"; print "<$sql>\n"; # <,,,,> $sql =~ s/(?<=,)(?=,)/NULL/g; print "<$sql>\n"; # <,NULL,NULL,NULL,>

However, editing SQL like this seems like it might not be the best approach. If you're using [mod://DBI] you should use [http://metacpan.org/pod/DBI#Placeholders-and-Bind-Values|placeholders], and if you're generating SQL, I recommend you look into modules that do that, like [mod://SQL::Abstract] ([id://1168493|example]).

(Update: [AnomalousMonk], [hippo], and [choroba] were a little faster :-) )
